title: When to Test, Repair, or Regenerate: Decision-Guided Efficient RTL Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28667v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs from natural-language specifications. To improve functional correctness, many RTL agents use simulation feedback to guide refinement. However, without a reference testbench, generating one for every initial implementation incurs inference cost even when the RTL is correct. We therefore introduce an adaptive harness that uses a specialized decision model to orchestrate testing, refinement, and candidate selection. It accepts high-scoring initial implementations and generates testbenches for the rest. When further search is needed, the initial score guides repair--regeneration allocation, while defect rankings and simulation feedback guide repair. For final selection, the harness prioritizes test-passing candidates and ranks them using decision-model scores. Across three benchmarks, the harness with DeepSeek improves mean Pass@1 by 5.4--7.1 percentage points

translated_title: 何时测试、修复还是重新生成：决策引导的高效RTL生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够根据自然语言规范生成寄存器传输级（RTL）设计。为了提高功能正确性，许多RTL智能体使用仿真反馈来指导优化。然而，在没有参考测试平台的情况下，为每个初始实现都生成测试平台，即使在RTL本身正确时也会产生不必要的推理成本。因此，我们引入了一个自适应框架，利用专门的决策模型来统筹测试、优化和候选选择。该框架接受高评分的初始实现，并仅为其余实现生成测试平台。当需要进一步搜索时，初始评分用于指导修复与重新生成之间的资源分配，而缺陷排序和仿真反馈则用于指导修复过程。在最终选择阶段，该框架优先考虑通过测试的候选方案，并依据决策模型的评分对其进行排序。在三个基准测试中，该框架结合DeepSeek使平均Pass@1提升了5.4至7.1个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出一种由专门决策模型引导的自适应框架，智能决定何时对RTL设计进行测试、修复或重新生成，从而在降低推理成本的同时，在三个基准上将平均Pass@1提升5.4至7.1个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an adaptive harness guided by a specialized decision model that intelligently determines when to test, repair, or regenerate RTL designs, improving mean Pass@1 by 5.4-7.1 percentage points across three benchmarks while reducing inference cost.
